cloud.en: Cold molecular cloud · mostly gas, some dust

accreting.en: Dense core collapses · gas feeds disk and protostar

diskClears.zh: 吸积减弱 · 周围盘逐渐消散

magnified.zh: 辨认镜头 · 大小随半径变化

formationDetail.en: Formation close-up · not a size ruler

formationScale.en: Cloud region · not on planetary-orbit scale

neutronDiameter.zh: 中子星约 24 km 直径 · 遗骸符号已放大
neutronDiameter.en: Neutron star ~24 km across · marker enlarged

blackHoleNoDisk.zh: 黑洞位置符号 · 不预设吸积盘

solarSystem.zh: 太阳系轨道 · 半径共用同一比例
solarSystem.en: Solar System orbits · shared radius scale

earth.zh: 地球 · 命运有模型差异

scale.zh: 成星阶段的云、盘、喷流和中心亮斑是保持同一位置的过程示意，不按行星轨道尺量；喷流不代表所有恒星都一样。成星后左图恒星半径与行星轨道共用线性比例，右图非线性放大。巨星仍近似圆形；阶段曲线和年龄为教学近似。
scale.en: During formation the cloud, disk, outflow and central glow illustrate one evolving location and are not on the planetary-orbit ruler; not every star has the same outflow. After formation the left star radius and planetary orbits share a linear scale; the right view is enlarged nonlinearly. The giant remains nearly round. Stage curves and ages are teaching approximations.

scaleMassive.zh: 成星阶段的云、盘、喷流和中心亮斑是同一位置的过程示意；大质量恒星可能在继续吸积时就开始聚变。成熟恒星的左图轮廓与 900 个太阳半径标尺共用线性比例，遗骸阶段虚线保留原外包层；右图非线性放大。无供气条件时不画黑洞吸积盘。阶段是教学插值，不是流体或核心坍缩求解。
scaleMassive.en: The formation cloud, disk, outflow and central glow illustrate one location; massive stars can begin fusion while still accreting. Mature-star outlines on the left share a linear scale with the 900-solar-radius ruler, and the dashed remnant-stage outline keeps the former envelope. The right view enlarges nonlinearly. No black-hole accretion disk is assumed without gas supply. Stages interpolate for teaching, not fluid dynamics or core collapse.

name.zh: 太阳型 · 约 1 个太阳质量

summary.zh: 从原恒星到核心氢聚变，再经红巨星、外层抛散成为白矮星。太阳不会沿这条路径形成黑洞。
summary.en: From protostar to core hydrogen fusion, then red giant, outer-layer loss and white dwarf. The Sun will not form a black hole on this path.

body.zh: 冷分子云以气体为主，只有少量尘埃。局部稠密云核受引力收缩，中心开始变亮；此时亮光来自收缩与吸积，尚不是稳定的核心氢聚变。
body.en: A cold molecular cloud is mostly gas with a little dust. A denser core collapses under gravity and its center begins to glow. Contraction and accretion power this early light, before sustained core hydrogen fusion.

body.zh: 物质向中心落下，旋转使部分气体形成扁平的吸积盘；有些形成中的恒星还沿轴向抛出物质。盘逐渐变薄，原恒星继续升温。喷流和盘是过程示意，不是流体计算。
body.en: Infall feeds the center while rotation flattens some gas into an accretion disk. Some forming stars also expel material along the axis. The disk thins as the protostar heats. Disk and outflow are process illustrations, not fluid calculations.

body.zh: 核心达到持续氢聚变的条件，氢变成氦并释放能量；原恒星成为主序星。图中从主序早期开始，太阳如今约 46 亿岁，仍处于这一漫长阶段。
body.en: Once the core sustains hydrogen fusion, hydrogen becomes helium and releases energy; the protostar joins the main sequence. The scene begins early in that phase. The Sun, now about 4.6 billion years old, is still in it.

body.zh: 核心氢供应减少，中心收缩变热，周围氢壳层开始更显著地供能。外层将响应内部变化，而不是突然换成另一颗星。
body.en: As core hydrogen runs low, the center contracts and heats while a surrounding hydrogen-burning shell becomes important. The envelope responds; this is still the same star.

body.zh: 松散包层向外扩张。按这个 180 倍太阳半径的代表性画面，轮廓跨过水星与金星轨道；地球最终是否被吞没还涉及太阳失重、轨道变化与潮汐，不能只看静态圆圈。
body.en: The loose envelope expands. At this illustrative 180-solar-radius anchor, the outline crosses Mercury’s and Venus’s orbits. Earth's eventual engulfment also depends on solar mass loss, orbit changes and tides; a static circle cannot decide it.

body.zh: 晚期外层被抛向太空，形成发光气体壳；名字叫行星状星云，却不是行星造出的。中心继续收缩，材料没有凭空消失。
body.en: Late outer layers leave the star as a glowing gas shell. Despite its name, a planetary nebula is not made by planets. The center contracts; the material has not vanished.

body.zh: 留下大致地球大小的致密核心，不再靠稳定核心聚变供能，仍会因余热发光并缓慢冷却。它不是小型黑洞。
body.en: An approximately Earth-sized dense core remains. Stable core fusion has ended, but stored heat still makes it glow as it slowly cools. It is not a small black hole.

name.zh: 大质量 · 约 15 个太阳质量

summary.zh: 高质量恒星更快消耗燃料；这里选择一次留下中子星的核心坍缩案例。质量不能单独精确决定每一颗星的终点。
summary.en: A high-mass star uses fuel faster. This example chooses a core-collapse outcome leaving a neutron star. Initial mass alone does not precisely predict every star’s endpoint.

body.zh: 冷云中一处稠密区域继续吸积大量气体，也可能同时形成别的恒星。云的范围是示意；它不是一颗边界清楚的大恒星。
body.en: A dense region of a cold cloud accretes much more gas, and other stars may form nearby. The cloud extent is illustrative, not the surface of one giant star.

body.zh: 落入的气体在旋转盘中向内输送，部分物质可能沿轴向流出。大质量原恒星可能尚在吸积时就开始核心聚变，因此盘消散与聚变开始并非突然切换的两帧。
body.en: Infalling gas moves inward through a rotating disk while some may flow outward along the axis. A massive protostar may begin core fusion while still accreting, so disk dispersal and fusion are not two abruptly separate frames.

body.zh: 更大的质量使核心须更快地产生能量来支撑外层，因此寿命通常只有数百万到数千万年，远短于太阳。
body.en: Greater mass requires the core to generate energy faster to support the envelope, so the lifetime is often millions to tens of millions of years, far shorter than the Sun's.

body.zh: 核心氢耗尽后，收缩和新的聚变阶段继续；不同燃料逐步接力，越往后持续越短。这里不把所有大质量恒星画成完全相同的内部洋葱层。
body.en: After core hydrogen runs out, contraction and later fusion stages follow. Successive fuels last less time. The drawing does not prescribe identical onion-like layers for all massive stars.

body.zh: 外层可能扩张到数百个太阳半径。它的大小不表示核心也同样巨大；画面中致密内部单独标出。
body.en: The envelope may expand to hundreds of solar radii. The core is not equally huge; the compact interior is marked separately.

body.zh: 当核心不再获得足够支撑，它迅速坍缩，外层可能以超新星方式抛出。冲击波和物质传播在这里是过程示意，不是爆炸速度计算。
body.en: When the core loses support it collapses rapidly, and the envelope can be expelled in a supernova. The shock and escaping matter here show the sequence, not a calculated blast speed.

body.zh: 这个案例留下直径约 24 千米的极致密中子星；左侧虚线保留坍缩前膨胀的外包层，让两者大小相差多少更容易想象。遗骸光点是放大的定位符，不能用它量实际直径。
body.en: This example leaves an extremely dense neutron star roughly 24 km across. The dashed outline at left keeps its former expanded envelope for context. The remnant dot is an enlarged locator, not a measurable diameter.

name.zh: 极大质量 · 约 30 个太阳质量

summary.zh: 这里选择形成恒星级黑洞的一个分支，不把 30 倍质量当成放之四海皆准的黑洞门槛。
summary.en: This example follows one stellar-black-hole outcome. Thirty solar masses is not a universal black-hole threshold.

body.zh: 稠密云核从以气体为主的分子云中收集物质；最终质量会改变之后的路径。中心初始亮度主要来自收缩和吸积。
body.en: A dense core gathers material from a mostly gaseous molecular cloud. Its final mass will affect the later path; early central light mainly comes from contraction and accretion.

body.zh: 气体经吸积盘继续流向原恒星，部分物质可能沿两极外流。大质量恒星的核心聚变与持续吸积可以重叠，画面让盘逐渐消散而不是瞬间换成另一颗星。
body.en: Gas continues through an accretion disk toward the protostar and some may flow out along the poles. Core fusion and continued accretion can overlap in massive stars; the disk fades rather than being replaced by another star at one instant.

body.zh: 巨大的核心压力要求很高的能量产率，因此代表性寿命只有几百万年。它并非太阳一路长大后的下一站。
body.en: Enormous core pressure requires a high energy output, giving a representative lifetime of only a few million years. It is not the Sun's next stage.

body.zh: 轻元素燃料逐步耗尽；质量损失、金属丰度和相伴恒星都会影响结局。
body.en: Successive light-element fuels run low. Mass loss, composition and companions can alter the outcome.

body.zh: 这里画一个有膨胀包层的示例。极大质量恒星并非都必经同一种红超巨星形态。
body.en: This example has an expanded envelope. Very massive stars do not all pass through the same red-supergiant form.

body.zh: 核心坍缩；外层抛射与回落的细节因恒星而异。画面不预言具体一颗星的爆发亮度或遗骸质量。
body.en: The core collapses. Ejection and fallback differ among stars. The scene predicts neither a particular explosion brightness nor a remnant mass.

body.zh: 这个分支留下恒星级黑洞。左侧虚线保留坍缩前的外包层；黑色记号只是位置符号，不能拿来量事件视界。吸积盘不是黑洞自带的：有些坍缩回落物能很快形成盘，另一些孤立遗骸则没有明亮的盘；本画面不预设供气。
body.en: This branch leaves a stellar black hole. The dashed outline retains the pre-collapse envelope; the dark mark locates the remnant but does not measure its horizon. An accretion disk is not intrinsic to a black hole: fallback can form one promptly in some collapses, while other isolated remnants lack a bright disk. This scene assumes no particular gas supply.
